title: Common definitions of the gateway and relay protocols, version 1
description: Shared by gateway-v1 (client to gateway over WebSocket) and relay-v1 (runner to gateway over TCP), see docs/komponenten/gateway.md.

version.description: Version of the gateway and relay protocols, carried by the opening messages.

match_id.description: Id of the match as the web API shows it.

seat.description: Secret of one side of an interactive match: 32 random bytes in base64url without padding. The web API hands it out once; only its hash is stored.

seat_hash.description: SHA-256 of the seat's text in lower-case hex.

line.description: One message of the game protocol as text, without line end: the bot protocol v1 for remote bots. At most 65536 characters; the referee also limits it to 65536 bytes.
